# Position Statement

**Context:** CORE-101
**Project:** P1-cycle-project
**Date:** 2026-04-15

---

## Element 1: My Stance

> I want my work to read as deliberate friction against the algorithmic smoothness AI tools encourage. The point is to leave my fingerprints on the decisions.

---

## Element 2: What Matters Most

> Every formal move must trace back to a stated intent. If I can't say why a thing looks the way it does, I haven't decided it yet.

---

## Element 3: What I Will Not Compromise On

> I will not accept AI proposals whose only justification is "this is what tools usually generate." Convention is not a reason.

---

## After the AI Session

**Drift level:** minor
**What shifted:**

> Briefly considered defaulting to AI-suggested type pairings; pulled back after the second cycle.

**Was the shift your decision, or did you follow AI's framing without questioning it?**

> Mine. I logged the rejection as Record #2.
